This meeting is to familiarize our human resource team with changes to the orientation program for new hires.
First, I'll give you a quick overview of these changes.
Then we'll see a video that was recently created for all new staff.
But we'll spend the majority of the meeting talking about the revisions to the employee handbook.
That will take about 40 minutes and then Shigeru will close with a brief review of the coaching process.
Since we only have an hour, I'd ask that you hold any questions until we've gotten through all the agenda points.
